title.narrative: Conditions in Rakhine State is improved and create grounds for eventual return of Rohingya refugees in a voluntary, safe and dignified manner.
Process towards finding solutions for Rohingyas reflects greater voices and wills of women and youth. Regional and international attention and support towards the Rohingya crisis is maintained.

target.value: Process towards finding solutions for Rohingyas reflects greater voices and wills of women and youth. Regional and international attention and support towards the Rohingya crisis is maintained.

actual.value: Conditions in Rakhine State have been barely improved, which intended to create grounds for return of Rohingya refugees in a voluntary, safe and dignified manner. Regional and international attention and supports towards the Rohingya crisis is maintained but neglected mostly due to the crisis in Ukraine.

title.narrative: Human rights, justice and accountability are integrated into a process of finding political solutions for the political and Rohingya crises.
Greater coherence and cooperation between human rights and justice actors and political actors in addressing the grievances and confidence building of affected population are improved.

target.value: Greater coherence and cooperation between human rights and justice actors and political actors in addressing the grievances and confidence building of affected population are improved.

actual.value: Human rights, justice and accountability are integrated into a process of finding lasting solutions for the political and Rohingya crises.

title.narrative: Promoting peaceful, democratic and inclusive Myanmar

A practical pathway is identified to discuss practical solutions for the political crisis. A vision for an inclusive, peaceful and democratic Myanmar duly reflects the will of the people, especially women and youth.

target.value: A practical pathway is identified to discuss practical solutions for the political crisis. A vision for an inclusive, peaceful and democratic Myanmar duly reflects the will of the people, especially women and youth.

title.narrative: Delivering humanitarian-plus assistance to affected people without discrimination
Humanitarian and other critical assistances reach increased number of conflict-affected areas and populations across the country.

target.value: A broad range of actors and stakeholders take part in facilitating equitable and impartial humanitarian access. Inclusive discussions and coordination around humanitarian assistance create an opportunity for actors and stakeholders to start the “talks for the talks”.

actual.value: The outreach of humanitarian assistance have increased in some of conflict-affected areas and populations across the country. A broad range of actors and stakeholders took part in facilitating equitable and impartial humanitarian access. Discussions and coordination around humanitarian assistance created an opportunity for actors and stakeholders to start "talks about talks" for possible peace negotiations. The mechanism of ASEAN-UN cooperation on "humanitarian-plus" has developed but poorly implemented.
